title: Choose Full14 source features
description: Build an openSynth Full14 source module with an optional global USB recorder.
introduction: Select openSynth and the optional global recorder, then compile that source selection on your computer.
planningNote: This preview builds source modules. Firmware installation and hardware release acceptance remain incomplete.
targetNote: This separate catalog targets the reviewed Full14 sources for Roland v5.52. The historical P6S feature preview remains available.
featureNote: Select openSynth first. Add the optional recorder to build its separate global source successor.
releaseScope: The first release focuses on Synth, global recording and USB updates. Autotune and stem splitting are planned for later.
shortcutNote: openSynth keeps the native SHIFT + RECORD SETTING entry. The optional recorder starts capture from the PC.
samplerShortcutScope: Requested scope: idle sampler/Generator lifecycle. This does not require audio transport to stop. Press the final control last, then release all controls to rearm.
normalUiShortcutScope: Requested preview scope: normal sampler, pattern, FX or utility screens. These screen restrictions have not been verified on the SP yet. The scope says nothing about USB audio transport.
unregisteredShortcutScope: No shortcut scope is registered for this feature.
shortcutLimit: Custom hardware shortcuts return an error until the Full14 dispatcher port is joined.
emptyShortcuts: Select a feature above to choose its shortcut.
emptySummary: No features selected. Choose a feature to start a configuration.
memoryNote: The source builder links the chosen module and checks its existing bounds. This does not qualify a composed firmware image.
receiptNote: Choose a local JSON receipt to compare it with your current choices. Only metadata is checked; firmware files and device results remain unverified.
receiptLimit: JSON, up to 128 KiB. This check does not connect to your SP.
saved: Source-preview choices saved in this browser.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Export your configuration to keep it.
transferNote: The local helper builds a module and its source receipt. It sends no firmware to the SP.
transferLimit: The optional global cohort still needs patcher admission and physical testing. Firmware installation stays disabled.
recordingNote: The PC recorder combines the OLED and control stream with existing stereo USB audio into recordings. Host fixtures and the P6S synth recordings provide scoped evidence; whole-SP recording on the optional v5.52 global route still needs hardware testing and requires patched firmware.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to edit, import or export a configuration. The feature status and update limits are available below.
footer: Full14 source preview. No device connection.
